$schema.description: Baseline snapshot for i18n audits. CI runs `bun run i18n:ci` and compares current counts to these numbers. Regression (any counter growing) fails CI even in warn-only mode; parity or improvement passes. Decreases should be committed alongside cleanup batches by running `bun run i18n:ci:update`.
$schema.note: Owned by the team; safe to lower as strings get translated. Never raise without justification.
